elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study immunised C57BL/6 mice with adjuvanted recombinant HA protein-based vaccines derived from genetically diverse H5 human isolates spanning 2003–2023. Neutralising antibody responses were assessed against seven H5 HA variants using pseudotyped and reassortant viruses in micro-neutralisation assays.
elements_en.methods: Neutralisation activity of sera was measured against seven H5 HA variants using pseudotyped viruses and a PR8-reassortant virus in micro-neutralisation assays. Mice were primed with either seasonal influenza infection or quadrivalent influenza vaccine (QIV) prior to H5 HA immunisation to examine the impact of pre-existing immunity on vaccine immunogenicity.
elements_en.main_results: The conventional vaccine strain A/Indonesia/05/2005 showed narrow activity against clade 2.3.4.4b viruses, while ancestral variants exhibited cross-neutralisation with limited potency. Polyvalent H5 HA formulations and nanoparticle-displayed H5 HA platforms broadened cross-neutralisation against diverse H5 strains. QIV pre-vaccination, but not prior influenza infection, enhanced subsequent neutralising responses towards A/Fujian-Sanyuan/21099/2017 (clade 2.3.4.4b) H5.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors conclude that immunogen selection and prior immunity critically shape antibody breadth following H5 HA immunisation. They demonstrate that polyvalent and nanoparticle-displayed H5 HA platforms can broaden cross-neutralisation, and that QIV pre-vaccination enhances responses to clade 2.3.4.4b H5, highlighting novel strategies for improving vaccine breadth.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings inform vaccine design by identifying immunogen platforms that broaden cross-neutralisation against diverse H5 strains, which is critical for pandemic preparedness. They also suggest that prior vaccination with QIV may prime responses to emerging clade 2.3.4.4b H5 viruses, informing future immunisation strategies.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to mouse models, which may not fully recapitulate human immune responses, and relies on pseudotyped virus neutralisation assays that may not capture all aspects of in vivo protection. The evidence strength is moderate due to the preclinical nature of the study and the absence of human data.

title_zh: 免疫原选择和先前的免疫影响禽 H5 血凝素免疫后的抗体广度
source_body_en: Avian influenza A viruses pose a persistent zoonotic threat to humans owing to their expanding host range and high case fatality rates. In particular, viruses from the 2.3.4.4b clade of the H5 subtype have now been detected in over 60 mammalian species, raising serious pandemic concerns. Understanding immune recognition of the H5 hemagglutinin (HA) is therefore critical for effective vaccine design and pandemic preparedness. To understand the breadth of cross-recognition induced by different H5 strains, we selected genetically diverse H5 human isolates from 2003-2023 and assessed neutralising antibody responses elicited by adjuvanted recombinant HA protein-based vaccines in C57BL/6 mice. Neutralisation activity of sera was determined against seven H5 HA variants using pseudotyped viruses and a PR8-reassortant virus in micro-neutralisation assays. Our results showed a wide variety of cross-strain neutralisation across H5 HA antigen variants. The conventional vaccine strain A/Indonesia/05/2005 displayed narrow activity against emerging clade 2.3.4.4b viruses, whereas ancestral variants exhibited cross-neutralisation profiles showing a diversity of breath but with limited potency. Polyvalent H5 HA formulations and nanoparticle-displayed H5 HA platforms substantially broadened cross-neutralisation against diverse H5 strains. To examine the impact of pre-existing immunity on H5 vaccine immunogenicity in mouse models, mice were primed with either seasonal influenza infection or quadrivalent influenza vaccine (QIV) prior to H5 HA immunisation. QIV pre-vaccination, but not prior influenza infection, enhanced subsequent neutralizing responses towards A/Fujian-Sanyuan/21099/2017 (clade 2.3.4.4b) H5. Collectively, our results demonstrate that immunogen selection and prior immunity shape antibody breadth following immunisation with avian A(H5) hemagglutinin.
abstract_zh: 禽流感 A 病毒由于 宿主 范围的扩大和高病死率,对人类构成持续的人畜共患病威胁。特别是,现已在 60 多种哺乳动物物种中检测到来自 H5 亚型 2.3.4.4b 进化枝的病毒,引发了严重的大流行担忧。因此,了解 H5 血凝素 (HA) 的免疫识别对于有效的 疫苗 设计和大流行防范至关重要。为了了解不同 H5 毒株诱导的交叉识别广度,我们选择了 2003-2023 年遗传多样性的 H5 人类分离株,并评估了基于佐剂重组 HA 蛋白的 疫苗 在 C57BL/6 小鼠中引发的中和抗体反应。在微量中和测定中,使用假型病毒和 PR8 重配病毒测定了血清针对七种 H5 HA 变体的中和活性。我们的结果显示 H5 HA 抗原变体具有多种跨菌株中和作用。传统的 疫苗 毒株 A/Indonesia/05/2005 对新出现的分支 2.3.4.4b 病毒表现出狭窄的活性,而祖先变种则表现出交叉中和特征,显示出呼吸多样性,但效力有限。多价 H5 HA 制剂和纳米颗粒展示的 H5 HA 平台大大拓宽了针对不同 H5 菌株的交叉中和作用。为了检查小鼠模型中预先存在的免疫力对 H5 疫苗 免疫原性的影响,在 H5 HA 免疫之前,对小鼠进行季节性流感感染或四价流感 疫苗 (QIV) 的免疫。疫苗接种 之前的 QIV(而非之前的流感感染)增强了对 A/福建三元/21099/2017(进化枝 2.3.4.4b)H5 的后续中和反应。总的来说,我们的结果表明,在用禽 A(H5) 血凝素免疫后,免疫原选择和先前的免疫决定了抗体的广度。

title: Mitigation of aflatoxin B1-induced toxicopathology and immunosuppression in broilers using a multimodal antioxidant formulation.
abstract: Aflatoxin B1 (AFB1) contamination of poultry feed impairs growth, immunity, and organ function, causing substantial economic losses. This study evaluated the protective efficacy of a multimodal, water-soluble antioxidant formulation (HI-RESIST®) against AFB1-induced toxicosis in broiler chickens. A total of 240 one-day-old Indian River broilers were randomized into six groups (n = 40): control, AFB1 (150 μg/kg feed), HI-RESIST® 1 (1 mL/L water), HI-RESIST® 2 (2 mL/L), AFB1 + HI-RESIST® 1, and AFB1 + HI-RESIST® 2. Treatments continued for 35 days. Outcome measures included body weight and feed intake, mortality, relative weights of thymus, bursa, liver, and kidney, innate (carbon-clearance assay) and cell-mediated (avian tuberculin) immune responses, humoral responses (SRBC, HI titers to Newcastle disease virus and H9 avian influenza), hematology (TEC, TLC, PCV, Hb), and serum biochemistry (ALT, AST, GGT, LDH, IL-33, BUN, creatinine, total protein, albumin, globulin), together with gross and histopathology of thymus, bursa, liver, and kidney. Dietary AFB1 produced the expected picture of aflatoxicosis: reduced feed intake and body weight gain, increased mortality, lymphoid organ involution, suppressed phagocytic and lymphoproliferative responses, lower antibody titers, anemia and elevated hepatic/renal biomarkers, and characteristic hepatic and renal histopathology (p < 0.05). HI-RESIST® supplementation ameliorated these effects in a dose-dependent manner; the 2 mL/L dose restored performance, immune parameters, hematobiochemical indices, and tissue morphology toward control values more effectively than 1 mL/L (statistically significant differences versus AFB1; p < 0.05). HI-RESIST® alone showed no adverse effects and, in some endpoints, enhanced immune and growth measures relative to control. In conclusion, HI-RESIST® administered in drinking water (particularly at 2 mL/L) substantially attenuated AFB1-induced immunotoxicity, hepatonephrotoxicity, and growth depression in broilers. These findings support the potential use of multimodal antioxidant supplementation as a practical strategy to mitigate aflatoxicosis in poultry; field validation and mechanistic studies are recommended.

A total of 240 one-day-old Indian River broilers were randomized into six groups (n = 40): control, AFB1 (150 μg/kg feed), HI-RESIST® 1 (1 mL/L water), HI-RESIST® 2 (2 mL/L), AFB1 + HI-RESIST® 1, and AFB1 + HI-RESIST® 2. Treatments continued for 35 days. Outcome measures included body weight and feed intake, mortality, relative weights of thymus, bursa, liver, and kidney, innate (carbon-clearance assay) and cell-mediated (avian tuberculin) immune responses, humoral responses (SRBC, HI titers to Newcastle disease virus and H9 avian influenza), hematology (TEC, TLC, PCV, Hb), and serum biochemistry (ALT, AST, GGT, LDH, IL-33, BUN, creatinine, total protein, albumin, globulin), together with gross and histopathology of thymus, bursa, liver, and kidney. Dietary AFB1 produced the expected picture of aflatoxicosis: reduced feed intake and body weight gain, increased mortality, lymphoid organ involution, suppressed phagocytic and lymphoproliferative responses, lower antibody titers, anemia and elevated hepatic/renal biomarkers, and characteristic hepatic and renal histopathology (p < 0.05). HI-RESIST® supplementation ameliorated these effects in a dose-dependent manner; the 2 mL/L dose restored performance, immune parameters, hematobiochemical indices, and tissue morphology toward control values more effectively than 1 mL/L (statistically significant differences versus AFB1; p < 0.05). HI-RESIST® alone showed no adverse effects and, in some endpoints, enhanced immune and growth measures relative to control. In conclusion, HI-RESIST® administered in drinking water (particularly at 2 mL/L) substantially attenuated AFB1-induced immunotoxicity, hepatonephrotoxicity, and growth depression in broilers. These findings support the potential use of multimodal antioxidant supplementation as a practical strategy to mitigate aflatoxicosis in poultry; field validation and mechanistic studies are recommended.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 家禽饲料中的黄曲霉毒素 B1 (AFB1) 污染会损害生长、免疫力和器官功能,造成重大经济损失。本研究评估了多模式水溶性抗氧化剂配方 (HI-RESIST®) 对 AFB1 诱导的肉鸡中毒的保护功效。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 总共 240 只一日龄印度河肉鸡被随机分为六组(n = 40):对照组、AFB1(150 μg/kg 饲料)、HI-RESIST® 1(1 mL/L 水)、HI-RESIST® 2(2 mL/L)、AFB1 + HI-RESIST® 1 和 AFB1 + HI-RESIST® 2。治疗 持续 35天。
elements_zh.methods: 结果测量包括体重和采食量、死亡率、胸腺、法氏囊、肝脏和肾脏的相对重量、先天和细胞介导的免疫应答、体液反应、血液学、血清生化以及胸腺、法氏囊、肝脏和肾脏的总体和组织病理学。
elements_zh.main_results: 日粮 AFB1 导致采食量和体重增加减少,死亡率 增加,淋巴器官退化,吞噬细胞和淋巴细胞增殖反应受到抑制,抗体滴度降低,贫血和肝/肾生物标志物升高,以及特征性肝和肾组织病理学 (p < 0.05)。HI-RESIST® 补充剂以剂量依赖性方式改善这些影响;2 mL/L 剂量比 1 mL/L 更有效地恢复性能、免疫参数、血液生化指数和组织形态,使其接近对照值(与 AFB1 相比具有统计学显着差异;p < 0.05)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在饮用水中施用 HI-RESIST®(特别是 2 mL/L)可显着减弱 AFB1 诱导的肉鸡免疫毒性、肝肾毒性和生长抑制。作者得出的结论是,多模式抗氧化剂补充剂可以减轻家禽的黄曲霉中毒。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持多模式抗氧化剂补充剂作为减轻家禽黄曲霉毒素中毒的实用策略的潜在用途。建议进行现场验证和机制研究,以确认商业环境中的有效性和安全性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在特定肉鸡品种和 AFB1 剂量的受控实验环境中进行的,限制了对田间条件的普遍适用性。由于缺乏长期随访且免疫和生化终点可能存在混杂,证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 家禽饲料中的黄曲霉毒素 B1 (AFB1) 污染会损害生长、免疫力和器官功能,造成重大经济损失。本研究评估了多模式水溶性抗氧化剂配方 (HI-RESIST®) 对 AFB1 诱导的肉鸡中毒的保护功效。总共 240 只一日龄印度河肉鸡被随机分为六组(n = 40):对照组、AFB1(150 μg/kg 饲料)、HI-RESIST® 1(1 mL/L 水)、HI-RESIST® 2(2 mL/L)、AFB1 + HI-RESIST® 1 和 AFB1 + HI-RESIST® 2。治疗 持续 35天。结果测量包括体重和采食量、死亡率、胸腺、法氏囊、肝脏和肾脏的相对重量、先天性(碳清除测定)和细胞介导的(禽结核菌素)免疫应答、体液反应(SRBC、新城疫病毒和 H9 禽流感 的 HI 滴度)、血液学(TEC、TLC、PCV、Hb)和血清生化(ALT、AST、GGT、LDH、IL-33、BUN、肌酐、总蛋白、白蛋白、球蛋白),以及胸腺、法氏囊、肝脏和肾脏的肉眼和组织病理学。日粮 AFB1 产生了黄曲霉中毒的预期结果:采食量和体重增加减少,死亡率 增加,淋巴器官退化,吞噬细胞和淋巴细胞增殖反应受到抑制,抗体滴度降低,贫血和肝/肾生物标志物升高,以及特征性肝肾组织病理学(p < 0.05)。HI-RESIST® 补充剂以剂量依赖性方式改善这些影响;2 mL/L 剂量比 1 mL/L 更有效地恢复性能、免疫参数、血液生化指数和组织形态,使其接近对照值(与 AFB1 相比具有统计学显着差异;p < 0.05)。单独使用 HI-RESIST® 没有表现出任何副作用,并且在某些终点上,相对于对照,增强了免疫和生长指标。总之,在饮用水中施用 HI-RESIST®(特别是 2 mL/L)可显着减弱 AFB1 诱导的肉鸡免疫毒性、肝肾毒性和生长抑制。这些发现支持多模式抗氧化剂补充剂的潜在用途,作为减轻家禽黄曲霉毒素中毒的实用策略;建议进行现场验证和机制研究。

title: Roles of Laboratory Animal Models in Zoonotic Diseases: A Review on Pathogenesis, Transmission, and Prevention Strategies
abstract: Emerging zoonotic diseases have become an increasing concern for global health due to the rising incidence of pathogen transmission from animals to humans. The present study aimed to comprehensively synthesize the current knowledge on zoonotic disease outbreaks and transmission, with a specific focus on evaluating the role, applications, advantages, and limitations of laboratory animal models in this field. A peer-reviewed literature search was conducted in PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar for studies published between 2000 and 2026, supplemented by earlier pivotal studies. The current study evaluated a range of models, including conventional, humanized, and transgenic mice, hamsters, ferrets, guinea pigs, rabbits, non-human primates, and emerging alternatives, focusing on their utility, strengths, and drawbacks for studying host-pathogen interactions, immune responses, tissue tropism, and disease progression. The present study underscored the importance of animal models in the preclinical assessment of antiviral agents, vaccines, monoclonal antibodies, and innovative therapeutic strategies. Recent outbreaks caused by pathogens such as SARS-CoV-2, Nipah virus, H5N1 influenza virus, Mpox virus, Ebola virus, Marburg virus, hantavirus, and Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever virus have highlighted the urgent necessity to enhance comprehension of zoonotic disease emergence and transmission. The current challenges included species-specific differences, translational limitations, reproducibility, and ethical considerations, as well as emerging alternatives such as organoids, organ-on-chip platforms, and computational modeling, all of which were addressed in the present findings. Integrating advanced animal models with One Health approaches can strengthen disease surveillance and accelerate therapeutic development.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the role of laboratory animal models in understanding zoonotic diseases, particularly avian influenza A viruses, with an emphasis on pathogenesis, transmission, and prevention strategies. The central question is to evaluate the utility, strengths, and limitations of these models in studying host-pathogen interactions, immune responses, tissue tropism, and disease progression.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review conducted a peer-reviewed literature search in PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar, including studies published between 2000 and 2026, with supplementary inclusion of earlier pivotal studies. The study design involved evaluating various animal models, including conventional, humanized, and transgenic mice, hamsters, ferrets, guinea pigs, rabbits, non-human primates, and emerging alternatives.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review emphasized the importance of animal models in preclinical assessments of antiviral agents, vaccines, monoclonal antibodies, and innovative therapeutic strategies. It also highlighted the need to address challenges such as species-specific differences, translational limitations, reproducibility, and ethical considerations.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identified challenges such as species-specific differences, translational limitations, reproducibility, and ethical considerations as significant issues in the use of animal models. Additionally, it noted the need for further exploration of emerging alternatives like organoids, organ-on-chip platforms, and computational modeling.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggested integrating advanced animal models with One Health approaches to strengthen disease surveillance and accelerate therapeutic development. It also called for continued research into improving the accuracy and applicability of these models for studying zoonotic diseases.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the role of laboratory animal models in studying avian influenza A viruses, focusing on their applications in understanding pathogenesis, transmission, and prevention strategies. The study highlights the importance of these models in preclinical assessments of antiviral agents and vaccines, while also addressing challenges such as species-specific differences and ethical concerns. It underscores the need for integrating advanced models with One Health approaches to enhance disease surveillance and therapeutic development. The review also identifies gaps in current methodologies and suggests the exploration of emerging alternatives like organoids and computational modeling to improve research outcomes.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注实验动物模型在了解人畜共患疾病(特别是 禽流感 A 病毒)方面的作用,重点是 发病机制、传播 和预防策略。核心问题是评估这些模型在研究 宿主-病原体相互作用、免疫应答、组织向性和疾病进展方面的效用、优势和局限性。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述在 PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science 和 Google Scholar 中进行了同行评审的文献检索,包括 2000 年至 2026 年间发表的研究,并补充纳入了早期的关键研究。研究设计涉及评估各种动物模型,包括传统、人源化和转基因小鼠、仓鼠、雪貂、豚鼠、兔子、非人类灵长类动物和新兴替代品。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述强调了动物模型在抗病毒药物制剂、疫苗、单克隆抗体及创新治疗策略临床前评估中的重要性。同时指出需解决物种特异性差异、转化限制、可重复性及伦理考量等挑战。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述将物种特异性差异、翻译限制、可重复性和伦理考虑等挑战确定为动物模型使用中的重大问题。此外,它指出需要进一步探索新兴替代品,如类器官、器官芯片平台和计算模型。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该评论建议将先进的动物模型与 One Health 方法相结合,以强化疾病 监测 并加速治疗开发。它还呼吁继续研究提高这些模型在研究人畜共患疾病方面的准确性和适用性。

abstract_zh: 由于病原体 发病率 从动物到人类的不断增加,新出现的人畜共患疾病已成为全球健康日益关注的问题。本研究旨在全面综合目前关于人畜共患疾病暴发和传播的知识,重点评估实验动物模型在该领域的作用、应用、优势和局限性。在 PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science 和 Google Scholar 上对 2000 年至 2026 年间发表的研究进行了同行评审的文献检索,并以早期的关键研究作为补充。目前的研究评估了一系列模型,包括传统、人源化和转基因小鼠、仓鼠、雪貂、豚鼠、兔子、非人类灵长类动物和新兴替代模型,重点关注它们在研究 宿主-病原体相互作用、免疫应答、组织向性和疾病进展方面的效用、优点和缺点。本研究强调了动物模型在 抗病毒药物 药物、疫苗、单克隆抗体和创新治疗策略的临床前评估中的重要性。最近由SARS-CoV-2、尼帕病毒、H5N1流感病毒、Mpox病毒、埃博拉病毒、马尔堡病毒、汉坦病毒和克里米亚-刚果出血热病毒等病原体引起的暴发凸显了加强对人畜共患疾病出现和传播的理解的迫切必要性。当前的挑战包括物种特异性差异、翻译限制、可重复性和伦理考虑,以及新兴替代品,如类器官、器官芯片平台和计算模型,所有这些都在本研究结果中得到解决。将先进的动物模型与 One Health 方法相结合可以强化疾病 监测 并加速治疗开发。

title: Newton Divided Difference Optimization for Fingerprint-Based Neural Virtual Screening against Avian Influenza A/H9N2
abstract: Avian influenza A/H9N2 poses persistent zoonotic and veterinary threats, yet efficient computational tools for antiviral compound prioritization remain underdeveloped, particularly with respect to optimizer behavior in high-dimensional neural screening. This study proposes Newton Divided Difference (NDD) optimization, a lightweight positive diagonal curvature-aware training strategy, as a novel optimizer for fingerprint-based neural virtual screening against avian influenza A/H9N2, with the objective of evaluating its performance across aligned molecular fingerprint representations and chemically structured validation protocols. An aligned benchmark of 1,459 molecules consisting of 615 candidate active compounds and 844 decoys was represented by EState (79 features), PubChem (881 features), and Klekota–Roth (4,860 features) fingerprints, sharing identical molecule identities, labels, and split assignments. A fixed multilayer perceptron (MLP) classifier was trained with NDD and seven baseline optimizers under stratified, scaffold-key, and similarity-cluster split protocols across five repeated seeds. NDD achieved the highest descriptive ROC-AUC (Receiver Operating Characteriztic – Area Under the Curve) and PR-AUC (Precision-Recall Area Under the Curve) on Klekota–Roth fingerprints under scaffold-key and similarity-cluster protocols, and remained competitive under the stratified split with ROC-AUC of 0.9872. Architecture-sensitivity tests confirmed stable NDD performance across multiple network configurations, with ROC-AUC values ranging from 0.9876 to 0.9890. Compared with Hessian-free optimization, NDD reduced per-run runtime from approximately 50–54 seconds to approximately 8 seconds on Klekota–Roth under the same CPU-only configuration while achieving comparable ranking performance. The novelty of this work lies in the first systematic assessment of NDD for H9N2 neural virtual screening, demonstrating that positive diagonal curvature-aware scaling provides a practical, stable, and computationally efficient optimization alternative in sparse high-dimensional ligand-based screening settings, although external validation and prospective experimental confirmation remain necessary before practical antiviral prioritization.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces Newton Divided Difference (NDD) optimization as a novel method for fingerprint-based neural virtual screening against avian influenza A/H9N2. The research highlights the need for efficient computational tools to prioritize antiviral compounds, especially in high-dimensional screening settings. The findings suggest that NDD offers a stable and computationally efficient alternative for antiviral prioritization. However, the study acknowledges the necessity of external validation and experimental confirmation before practical application. The results are promising for improving screening methods but require further testing to ensure their real-world applicability.

abstract_zh: 禽流感 A/H9N2 造成持续的人畜共患病和兽医威胁,但用于 抗病毒药物 化合物优先级排序的有效计算工具仍然不发达,特别是在高维神经筛选中的​​优化器行为方面。本研究提出了牛顿除差(NDD)优化,这是一种轻量级正对角曲率感知训练策略,作为针对 禽流感 A/H9N2 的基于指纹的神经虚拟筛选的新型优化器,目的是评估其在对齐的分子指纹表示和化学结构验证协议中的性能。由 615 种候选活性化合物和 844 种诱饵组成的 1,459 个分子的对齐基准由 EState(79 个特征)、PubChem(881 个特征)和 Klekota–Roth(4,860 个特征)指纹代表,共享相同的分子身份、标签和分割分配。固定多层感知器 (MLP) 分类器使用 NDD 和七个基线优化器在分层、支架键和相似性聚类分割协议下跨五个重复种子进行训练。NDD 在支架密钥和相似性聚类协议下的 Klekota–Roth 指纹上实现了最高的描述性 ROC-AUC(接收者操作特征 - 曲线下面积)和 PR-AUC(曲线下精确召回面积),并且在分层分割下保持竞争力,ROC-AUC 为 0.9872。架构敏感性测试证实了跨多种网络配置的稳定 NDD 性能,ROC-AUC 值范围为 0.9876 至 0.9890。与无 Hessian 优化相比,在相同的仅 CPU 配置下,NDD 将 Klekota-Roth 上的每次运行时间从大约 50-54 秒减少到大约 8 秒,同时实现了相当的排名性能。这项工作的新颖性在于首次系统评估 H9N2 神经虚拟筛选的 NDD,证明正对角线曲率感知缩放在稀疏高维配体筛选设置中提供了实用、稳定且计算高效的优化替代方案,尽管在实际 抗病毒药物 优先级排序之前仍然需要外部验证和前瞻性实验确认。
